title: Frontend Engineer
description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~3–5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Frontend Engineer you own the web applications people use to run our instrument and read its results: an operator console that configures and runs scans with live camera and stage data, and a reconstruction front-end for setting up runs and inspecting images. Your users are the engineers in our lab, so feedback is immediate. You work closely with the Embedded, Software and Algorithm engineers who build the systems behind your interfaces. What you will do Build and maintain the frontends of our acquisition and reconstruction applications, from design to release. Develop real-time views of camera images, stage positions and scan progress streamed from the instrument. Design clear, safe operator workflows for configuring and running measurements. Keep a shared design system and component library across our applications. Extend the Python and C# backends where a feature needs it, together with the backend owners. Take part in code review and bring good frontend practice to the team: typing, testing, CI. Your profile BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. ~3–5 years of experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript. Experience with real-time or data-heavy interfaces (WebSockets, streaming data, canvas or WebGL rendering). Strong CSS and a feel for clean, usable interface design. Working knowledge of Python or C# and REST APIs. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience building software for scientific instruments, industrial machines or other hardware. Experience with image or scientific data visualization. Experience with FastAPI or ASP.NET Core, end-to-end testing (Playwright, Cypress), or working in a Scrum team. Interest in optics, imaging or semiconductor metrology. What we offer Ownership of the user-facing software of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product. Work at the meeting point of software, optics and hardware, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.
